text:
The photo shows tofu cubes on a white plate. The plate looks like a square side plate of about 20 cm, set on paper with QR codes.

I counted roughly 20 cubes. Most are about 2.5 to 3 cm per side, which is roughly 15 to 20 cm³ each, or about 16 g at tofu density. A few are smaller. Twenty cubes at about 14 g each comes to about 280 g, and I rounded that to 250 g to allow for the smaller ones.

The cubes look pale and firm, so I'm treating them as firm tofu at about 144 kcal per 100 g. If it is soft tofu the figure would be lower, around 80 kcal per 100 g.
